title: prosebook catalog
description: Generated by `prosebook generate` from the config. Do not edit.

kind.description: What sort of string it is.

oneOf.description: Identifies a thing so it can be found again. One to four words, a noun phrase, no period.
Says what pressing it does. One to three words, verb first, no period.
Adds only what the name cannot carry. One sentence, two at most, with a period.
Reports what is true right now. One sentence, present tense; on an error or empty state, one more saying what to do.
The text of a button or a menu entry.
Reached only by a screen reader, so nothing on screen carries it.
One option among a set offered together.
The question of a confirmation, or the verb that answers it.
A phrase beside or under the thing it qualifies: a row's detail line, a reading, a count. Not a sentence, so a state here ends without a period.
Fills a list or a panel that has nothing in it.
Heads a section, group, dialog or list.
A subordinate line under the thing it qualifies.
Names a control, a field, a section or a destination.
Sits inside an empty field, and goes when typing starts.
Reports what is true right now, on a badge or beside a row.
The title of a page, window or document.
A notification that comes and goes.

context.description: One sentence telling a translator where the string appears and what it answers to.

closed.description: Select arguments that take only the arms they name: a call site can't pass another value.

min.description: The least each plural count can be (`sites: 2`), so its plural needs only the forms counts from there take.

fragment.description: Completes something beside it rather than standing as a sentence.

comment.description: A change asked of whoever edits the entry next. Make it, then delete the comment.

remove.description: Asks for the entry to go: delete it, its translations and the code that reads it.

allow.description: Lint rules this entry is exempt from, each with the reason.
